description: Add a guidance hint at domain level — applies to ALL projects in the domain, not just one project. Use for cross-section principles: solicitor navigation, discretion model, raw-facts principle. These hints are retrieved automatically during generation for any project in the domain. Use adherence='exact' with process_type='section_discovery' to specify exactly which sections the SME wants — the LLM will follow them precisely.

adherence.description: How strictly the LLM must follow this hint. 'exact' = must follow, produce nothing beyond what is specified (use for SME-defined section lists); 'guided' = strong preference, may adapt if source text requires (default); 'loose' = soft suggestion.

notes.description: SME commentary or legislation provenance. Never sent to LLM.

process_type.description: Which authoring phase this hint targets — rule_generation (default), field_extraction, or section_discovery

name: aethis_add_domain_guidance
